name: Javelin of Lightning
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 156, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 471
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 156, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 471
Aura faint evocation CL 5th
Slot none; Price 1,500 gp; Weight 2 lbs.
Description
This javelin becomes a 5d6 lightning bolt when thrown (Reflex DC 14 half). It is consumed in the attack.
Construction
Requirements Craft Magic Arms and Armor, lightning bolt; Price 750 gp
